_comment: Reference for the RED microwave (Comfee, red finish). A DIFFERENT appliance
from the cream Comfee: different panel colour and different button labelling
-- this one reads 'START +30s' where the cream reads 'START +30SEC.'.
Source: frame 27 of IMG_3824.MP4, the sharpest frame in that clip with the
button_xy was placed by fitting a circle to the button on the source frame,
not by eye. Every prediction is this one point carried through the fitted
transform, so an error here appears in every frame; on the cream reference an
eyeballed mark was ~3px off and the bias was invisible to every automated
score because the eval labels shared it.
NOT VALIDATED. The cream reference was measured on 29 labeled frames; this
one has no eval behind it at all. It is built from PHONE video, so it may or
may not match a live camera -- run check_reference_match.py before trusting
it, and rebuild from a camera frame with make_reference.py if it does not.
